1/ 📈 WWSCAN Weekly Data

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 2/ COVID-19: Nationwide, SARS-CoV-2 is in the ‘Low’ category with low concentrations and a downward trend over the last 3 weeks. https://t.co/N7bvPdITby

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 3/ COVID-19 Variants: In sequencing data from a subset of WWSCAN sites, we are seeing the LP.8.1 variant (KP.1 descendant) in brown (62%) & other KP.1 variants in light green (2.8%) make up ~ 65% of variants. Note sequencing data has a longer lag of 1-2 weeks after collection. https://t.co/VJsk3fUC0I

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 4/ Influenza: Nationally, Flu A and Flu B are in the ‘Low’ category and not in seasonal onset. About 7% and 22% of sites are in seasonal onset for Flu A and Flu B, respectively. https://t.co/7KqadIRpq0

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 5/ H5 influenza marker: H5 has been detected in 27 states since monitoring began - 6 in the West, 7 in the Midwest, 8 in the South, and 6 in the Northeast. As of 5/30/25, 17 states have also reported infected cattle herds. Most recent WW detections have been in AK, NC and NJ. https://t.co/4pSrL0pw2O

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 6/ RSV: RSV is in the ‘Low’ category nationally and not in seasonal onset. About 3% of sites are still in seasonal onset for RSV. https://t.co/nnik03RMPr
